capabilities: Open EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2 and CBZ files in a reader
Read books aloud with on-device text-to-speech
Annotate passages with marks, notes and bookmarks
Build a library of title notes with reading status and ratings
Export books and annotations to PDF, Markdown or EPUB
extras: Optional features (book sources, look-up dictionaries, library, reading records, voices) stay off until enabled in Settings → Orbis Reader → Setup. Interface is English only and has not been tested with screen readers. Book files are never modified; reading data is stored in a .orbis-data folder beside each book.
problem: Obsidian cannot open ebook files, so reading and the notes taken while reading stay outside the vault and its links.

relations.evidence: Browse, search and download books from Project Gutenberg (built in)
your own Calibre server and other OPDS-compatible sources

summary: Ebook reader for the vault that opens EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2 and CBZ files and adds text-to-speech, annotations, a library and exports.
